_note: Street Runner's delivery sources in San Francisco (src/game/delivery.ts `sources`). Every name is INVENTED, on purpose: no real business is named or implied. Places are where such a kitchen would plausibly be (dim sum in Chinatown, steak downtown). `fragile`: a collision after pickup spoils it and the job is off. lat/lon: a point on the block; the nearest building becomes the pickup.

restaurants.name: The Golden Crank Dumpling House
restaurants.blurb: Dim sum so fresh the har gow still has opinions.

items.name: kung pao chicken
items.blurb: Extra peanuts, because you clearly need the protein.

items.name: lo mein
items.blurb: Nine feet of noodle, coiled for aerodynamics.

items.name: pork buns
items.blurb: Soft as a saddle you will never own.

restaurants.name: Lucky Spoke Noodle Bar
restaurants.blurb: Hand-pulled noodles, pulled by a former track sprinter.

items.name: hot and sour soup
items.blurb: Scalding, sloshy, and absolutely not spill-proof.

items.name: dan dan noodles
items.blurb: Numbing pepper for the hills ahead.

restaurants.name: Jade Derailleur Tea House
restaurants.blurb: Eleven gears of oolong. Shifts smoothly under load.

items.name: egg tarts
items.blurb: Custard wobble rated for zero potholes.

items.name: sesame balls
items.blurb: Round, golden, roll downhill if dropped.

restaurants.name: Nonna's Hill-Climb Cannoli
restaurants.blurb: Nonna rode up Telegraph Hill daily until she was 94. Show some respect.

items.name: cannoli
items.blurb: Shell crisp, filling piped to order, structural integrity: poor.

items.name: focaccia
items.blurb: Dimpled like a well-used saddle.

restaurants.name: Pedal-Pushers Pizzeria
restaurants.blurb: Wood-fired. The wood was a bike shop's old workbench.

items.name: margherita pizza
items.blurb: Keep the box flat. Keep the box FLAT.

items.name: garlic knots
items.blurb: Ward off vampires and drafting rivals.

restaurants.name: The Brake Lever Chophouse
restaurants.blurb: Where the Financial District expenses its feelings.

items.name: dry-aged ribeye
items.blurb: Aged 45 days, delivered in 15 minutes. Ideally.

items.name: bottle of cabernet
items.blurb: Glass, liquid, expensive: three reasons to ride gently.

restaurants.name: Brass Bell Grill & Oyster Room
restaurants.blurb: Ring the bell for service. Ring it twice and they fine you.

items.name: steak frites
items.blurb: Fries are to be eaten hot, so pedal like it.

items.name: oysters on ice
items.blurb: A dozen, on ice, on a bike. What could go wrong.

restaurants.name: Señor Sprocket's Taquería
restaurants.blurb: Burritos the size of a rear pannier.

items.name: super burrito
items.blurb: Two pounds of carnitas, rice and destiny.

items.name: horchata
items.blurb: Cinnamon, ice, and a lid that does not quite fit.

items.name: tacos al pastor
items.blurb: Pineapple included, opinions not.

restaurants.name: Uncle Chainring's Bagel Depot
restaurants.blurb: Bagels boiled, baked, and slightly out of true.

items.name: everything bagel
items.blurb: Shedding seeds in your bag forever after.

items.name: lox and schmear
items.blurb: Cold-smoked salmon, warm-hearted service.

restaurants.name: Top of the Hill Delicatessen
restaurants.blurb: You climbed Nob Hill for this. It is worth it. Mostly.

items.name: pastrami on rye
items.blurb: Stacked higher than California Street is steep.

items.name: matzo ball soup
items.blurb: Grandma-grade, lid-optional.

restaurants.name: Thirteen-Spoke Bagels & Lox
restaurants.blurb: Open since breakfast was invented, roughly.

items.name: bagel dozen
items.blurb: Thirteen, actually. The baker cannot count.

items.name: black-and-white cookies
items.blurb: Half vanilla, half chocolate, fully crumbly.

restaurants.name: Low-Gear Creamery
restaurants.blurb: Ice cream churned at the exact temperature of a Marina July.

items.name: salted caramel ice cream
items.blurb: Melting as you read this. Crash once and it is soup.

items.name: mint chip pint
items.blurb: Keep it upright, keep it cold, keep it moving.

restaurants.name: Gearshift Gelato
restaurants.blurb: Psychedelic flavours, conventional cones.

items.name: pistachio gelato
items.blurb: One pothole and it is a smoothie.

items.name: affogato kit
items.blurb: Espresso and gelato, travelling separately, briefly.

restaurants.name: Two-Wheel Scoop Shop
restaurants.blurb: Across from the park, so everyone wants it, now.

items.name: brown butter ice cream
items.blurb: Delicate, delicious, doomed if you hit a car.

restaurants.name: Tailwind & Tannin Wine Merchants
restaurants.blurb: Natural wine, natural light, natural smugness.

items.name: bottle of pinot noir
items.blurb: Sonoma's finest, swaddled in one sad sheet of tissue.

items.name: champagne
items.blurb: Shaken, it becomes a fire extinguisher.

restaurants.name: Kickstand Ramen Counter
restaurants.blurb: Broth simmered for 18 hours; your ride should take 18 minutes.

items.name: tonkotsu ramen
items.blurb: A litre of molten broth in a plastic tub. Ride like a monk.

items.name: sushi platter
items.blurb: Arranged with tweezers. Please do not do wheelies.

restaurants.name: Spoke and Broth Noodle Café
restaurants.blurb: Half bike shop, half noodle shop, all broth.

items.name: pho tai
items.blurb: Herbs on the side, soup everywhere if you crash.

items.name: bánh mì
items.blurb: Crusty baguette, rated for minor turbulence.

restaurants.name: Low Tide Oyster Counter
restaurants.blurb: Oysters so fresh they were in the Bay this morning. Hopefully not the bit under the bridge.

items.name: oyster dozen
items.blurb: On crushed ice. Twelve tiny trust exercises.

items.name: crab sandwich
items.blurb: Dungeness, mayo, and a mild sense of occasion.

restaurants.name: Bread Bowl Bob's Chowder Shack
restaurants.blurb: The bowl is bread. The bread is a bowl. Bob is a legend.

items.name: clam chowder in a bread bowl
items.blurb: The bowl holds. Until it does not.

items.name: sourdough loaf
items.blurb: Tangy, crusty, practically indestructible.

restaurants.name: Burger Bottom Bracket
restaurants.blurb: Two smashed patties, one smashed record.

items.name: double cheeseburger
items.blurb: Keep it level, keep it moving.

items.name: chocolate milkshake
items.blurb: Thick, cold, and absolutely not crash-rated.

restaurants.name: Coaster Brake Bakery
restaurants.blurb: Layer cakes engineered by a retired bridge inspector.

items.name: birthday cake
items.blurb: Three tiers, one rider, zero margin for error.

items.name: morning buns
items.blurb: Cinnamon sugar on everything you own.

restaurants.name: Ninety RPM Coffee Roasters
restaurants.blurb: Single-origin beans, roasted at 90 rpm.

items.name: tray of lattes
items.blurb: Four flat whites in a cardboard tray of hope.

items.name: bag of beans
items.blurb: Whole bean, rattles like a loose spoke.

restaurants.name: Pagoda of the Pedals
restaurants.blurb: The Richmond's answer to Chinatown, with parking for bikes only.

items.name: xiao long bao
items.blurb: Soup inside dumplings. Physics is not on your side.

items.name: roast duck
items.blurb: Glossy, crackling, and it fits in the bag (barely).
